name: create-sdk-vs-raw
caption:
Both adapters use the same raw HTTPX delete for cleanup. Cycle throughput is not full SDK create+kill throughput.
Points: per-run median; bands: run min–max; 3 runs per point. Sequential execution does not isolate SDK overhead.

name: warmup-c8-to-c64
caption:
Left: median throughput and run min–max. Right: per-run rates (dots) and pooled first-call counts (horizontal lines).
Every slot running once at C8 does not prove that all connections needed at C64 are pre-established. The conditions were not randomized.
